material_definitions: The Li+ superionic argyrodites Li6+xP1-xGexS5I were synthesized by substituting Ge4+ for P5+.
Full solid solutions can be synthesized up to a composition of at least Li6.7P0.3Ge0.7S5I.
Conductivity was measured using temperature-dependent impedance spectroscopy on cold-pressed pellets.
Sintering the cold pressed pellets at 823 K for ten minutes further increases conductivity.

material_definitions: The class of argyrodites Li6PS5X (X = Cl, Br, I) has attracted considerable interest.
The iodine containing argyrodites, Li6PS5I, show no site-disorder due to the large size mismatch between S2– and I–.
The absence of disorder is associated with high activation barriers for ion migration.
warnings: Temperature is inferred to be room temperature (25 C).
Data is cited from an external source (Kraft et al.).
